# G1-04 — catalog, presets and engine changes after Wave 0 (for G2, G3, G4, G5)

Branch `v2-g1`. Nothing here changes a frozen contract except the additive field in G1-02.

## Catalog (src/data/tytax/*.json, generated by `npm run catalog:build`)
- 1,409 TYTAX exercises (1,436 source entries − 27 promo/delivery/overview videos, identified by source metadata: no
  `exerciseLevel` and T1-X number ≤ 13). All 1,420 pre-v2 ids are kept except 11 of those videos (list:
  docs/v2/catalog-reconciliation.md). Ids are frozen in scripts/data/id-registry.json. Four entries whose source name is
  not a title (e.g. `NEvUVCFF8x8`) get a reviewed display name; the source name stays their legacy key.
- **Station ids are now the tytax_library.json keys**: `SMITH`, `BACK_UPPER`, `BACK_LOWER`, `LEG_EXTENSION`,
  `LEG_CURL` (Wave 0 had `smith`, `back-upper`, … and a bogus `tytax`). Attachment ids: `D_HANDLES`,
  `TRICEPS_ROPE`, `STRAIGHT_BAR`, `V_HANDLE`, `ANKLE_STRAP`, `AB_STRAP`, `LAT_BAR`, `EZ_LAT_BAR`, `DIP_BELT`.
  Read them from `catalog.loadCatalog().stations/.attachments`; never hard-code the old ones.
  **G4** (exercise filters, equipment inventory) and **G2** (EquipmentInventory stationIds/attachmentIds) are affected.
- 145 exercises have no station (free weights, frame pull-ups/dips, stretches, a few ambiguous machine moves):
  docs/v2/station-unresolved.md. Bodyweight ones carry `requiresEquipment` (`pull-up-bar`, `dip-station`, `none`).
- `Exercise.legacyName` is the tytax-autonomous name ("TYTAX T1 | X" for the 118 master exercises, else the plain
  name). **G2 legacy import**: use `src/data/tytax/legacy-names.json` (legacy name → id; includes both the
  "TYTAX T1 | X" and plain forms, and one alias) or `catalog.getByLegacyName(name)` (matches legacyName, name, the
  generated map and aliases, case-insensitive, also after the original app's `cleanName`, which strips `TYTAX T1 |`).

## Presets (src/lib/programs/presets.ts)
- `DEFAULT_TYTAX_PRESET_ID` is now `'tytax-original-6day'`: the original app's INITIAL_PLAN (Upper A, Lower A,
  Upper B, Lower B, Upper C, Lower C, Rest Day; session ids `tytax-original-6day-<slug>`). Use the constant, not a
  literal. `'tytax-elite-v3'` still exists (its 15 dangling exercise ids are fixed). Every preset id resolves
  (data-integrity test). **G3** program-rotation spec and **G4** programs page: prefer the constant.

## Training engine (src/lib/training)
- Prefill: only `working` sets drive progression; 0 kg (bodyweight) never gets +2.5 kg; kettlebells hold unless
  `availableKg` (e.g. `EquipmentInventory.kettlebellsKg`) is passed — **G3** please pass it.
- `detectPRs`: e1RM PRs only for sets ≤ 12 reps; new `reps` PRs for 0 kg sets. **G3** live PR flash should mirror.
- ACWR: chronic load over the weeks of history available (1–4); a new user is no longer `fried` after one session.

## Analytics (src/lib/analytics)
- `computeWeeklyVolume(logs, { lookup })`, `volumeByMuscle(logs, { lookup })`, `analyzeMuscleGaps(logs, days,
  { now, lookup })` take the lazy-catalog lookup; without it they fall back to `muscleImpactSnapshot`, which
  program-started workouts do not have. **G4** `use-analytics-data.ts`: pass `lookup`.
- `computeVolumeParity` needs a lookup (no eager catalog fallback any more; that fallback put the 810 KB catalog
  into /analytics first-load JS).

## Bundle budget
- `npm run build && npm run check-bundle` → `/dashboard` first-load JS 204.7 kB gzip (< 250 kB); the catalog-leak scan
  covers every route's first-load chunks, preload links and inline RSC payload. `--route /settings` is 274.8 kB (over; not AC8's route) — **G4/G5**: the settings page pulls
  a large client dependency (likely the Supabase client); worth a dynamic import.

## IDs
- `generateId()` in `@/lib/utils` works on plain-http LAN (no `crypto.randomUUID` there). **G3** workout store
  still calls `crypto.randomUUID` directly (review R06).
